product_metadata.title: Greenland Home Watercolor Dream Quilt Set, 3-Piece King/Cal King, White
features: Cheer up your sleeping space with the artfully chic watercolor dream quilt set
Sprouts of color Bloom beside stenciled flower illustrations on a white ground
description: Cheer up your sleeping space with the artfully chic watercolor dream quilt set. Sprouts of color bloom beside stenciled flower illustrations on a white ground. Reverses to a coordinating solid color for two looks in one. Oversized for better coverage on today's deeper mattresses. Prewashed and preshrunk 100percent cotton face and back with 100percent cotton fill. Machine quilted with fabric bound edges for durability and surface interest. Quilt set comes with quilt and two pillow shams (one sham per twin set). dimensions: twin set includes one 68x88" quilt and one 20x26" pillow sham, full/Queen set includes one 90x90" quilt plus two 20x26" pillow shams, King set includes one 105x95" quilt plus two 20x36" pillow shams.
